additionalRequirements.text: Including optional support for OR search on `status` (e.g.`status=[status],[status],...`)

requiredSearches.searchGuidance: See [how to search by reference](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/search.html#reference) and [how to search by token](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/search.html#token).

requiredSearches.rationale: Supports patient-scoped retrieval of Task resources filtered by code for USCDI+ Quality workflows.
requiredSearches.statement: searching for all Task resources for a patient using the combination of the `patient` and `code` search parameters

additionalRequirements.text: Including optional support for OR search on `code` (e.g.`code={system|}[search_code],{system|}[search_code],...`)

requiredSearches.searchGuidance: See [how to search by reference](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/search.html#reference) and [how to search by token](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/search.html#token).
